description: Fires when more than 5% of the reference agent's tool invocations end in an errored span. Tool spans are emitted by instrument.tool_span(), which sets status ERROR and records the exception when a tool raises -- so has_error = true is the agent failing to use its own tools, not the model giving a wrong answer. A healthy suite run leaves this rule quiet, which is why it is expressed as a rate rather than a raw count: one flaky call in a large run is noise, one in five is a broken tool.

annotations.summary: {{$value}}% of tool calls are erroring on commit {{$labels.vcs_commit_sha}} (ceiling {{$threshold}}%)
annotations.description: Tool spans with has_error = true as a percentage of all tool spans. Open the 'Preflight - Tool Trajectory' dashboard: the 'Tool errors by tool name' table names the failing tool, and 'Tool calls by tool and commit' shows whether the trajectory changed at the same time.

filter.expression: attribute.eval.run_id EXISTS AND attribute.preflight.span_role = 'tool' AND has_error = true
